NPC Tống Thiết / NPC-HN-FORGE. ALL18poses remain WEST true left-facing side profile, identical camera and body axes to IMAGE1. Keep the whole actor in true left-facing profile in all18poses. ROW IDLE6: frame1: Directional neutral calibration with both boots planted; frame2: Small inhalation in shoulders/cloth only; frame3: Slight sleeve/shoulder breathing change; frame4: Gentle exhalation without full-body bob or scaling; frame5: Subtle blink where eyes are actually visible, otherwise a settled shoulder/hair detail; frame6: Return to same source frame1 directional neutral.

Hair/robe/back construction is the minimal continuation of accepted identity: no extra emblems, pouches, decorations, hidden weapons, embroidery or face redesign. Motion is stationary with stable boots and genuine small pose changes; no six static duplicate images, full-body bobbing/scaling or camera rotation. Any naturally lower bounds while looking down remain natural, not normalized. New view/action is a candidate for review; owner acceptance of Southeast does not approve seven new views or runtime.
